title: Also this poster is SO cute, like where can I get one? 🥺👉👈 #Paddingto...
transcript: It looks like Paddington might finally be announcing its Broadway transfer, as these posters have started popping up all over Midtown. And I'm kind of loving this trend of, like, soft announcing shows with posters. Obviously Evita just did this. I remember Operation Mincemeat did something similar. Seems to be all of the British imports, but in regards to Paddington, I don't think that this will come as a huge shock to most people, as Paddington has been rumoured to come to Broadway for a while. I believe producers had gone on record and been like, yeah, we're working on it. Plus it was even teased on the Tony Awards this past weekend. But still very exciting. I have been dying for this show to come to New York ever since they showed off that puppet. Plus it got amazing reviews in London. Everyone I know that has seen it has loved it. And I have very intentionally avoided anything about this show. I haven't listened to any of the music, I don't know what the plot is. I really want the first time that I experience it to be in the theatre. So this transfer cannot come soon enough. I imagine with the official announcement, we'll find out when it's actually coming, what theatre is going into, when tickets will go on sale. So keep an eye out for that over the next few days.
classificationReason: Commentary about Paddington's rumored Broadway transfer based on posters appearing in Midtown; Paddington is not in the provided show list, and the creator explicitly states they have not seen or listened to anything about the show.
